description:
Create the new dedicated emulator scenario, using vrooli-emulator as the working scenario name, as a reusable Linux-first validation service.

The implementation should reuse proven concepts from scenario-to-desktop livedesktop and smoketest work, but rehome them behind clean service boundaries so other deployment ramps and deployment-manager can consume one shared emulator app instead of each owning their own ad hoc validation logic.
name: vrooli-emulator-linux-first
title: Build The Dedicated Emulator Service Linux First
